silhouette.reason: Reads as the revision concept lantern at 0.35 m: a 20-band width profile of the -Y orthographic render (480 x 896 px at 0.390625 mm/px) against the approved front reference (454 x 914 px) correlates r=0.947 with MAD 0.050; aspect 0.536 versus 0.497 (7.9 percent wider, extra width in the cage band). All key parts present in order: closed bail, small vent cap, domed shoulder, four-post cage with side guard bars, rope-wrapped base. 3872 triangles, 1 material, 4 textures.

orientation.reason: Upright on +Z with a flat base at z=0.0000 and crown at z=0.3500 m (fresh BLENDER_PROCESS 2026-11-24T10:04:13Z; reimport z min -1.46e-08). Forward -Y: the -Y orthographic view shows the reference front burner side-arm on image-right, matching the approved front; plan extents 0.18769 m X by 0.17915 m Y, X 4.8 percent wider as in the concept front; FBX reimport keeps 0.3500000086 m height and the same plan sizes.

pivot.reason: Origin at base centre: object matrix_world is identity, location (0,0,0), world bbox min (-0.093847,-0.089577,0.000000) and max (+0.093847,+0.089577,+0.350000); XY bbox centre (0.0000,0.0000), base plane z=0. FBX reimport pivot (0.0, 2.98e-08, -1.46e-08) and size 0.3500000086 m, so no offset or scale drift.

interaction.reason: The bail is a closed hoop joined at both ends to the cap: the enclosed background region survives binary_fill_holes in the staged preview and in a -Y orthographic render. The opening is 229 x 166 px = 89.5 x 64.8 mm at 0.390625 mm/px (preview-corrected 85.6 x 65.6 mm), versus the concept opening 197 x 150 px = 75.4 x 57.4 mm; no cage or cap geometry crosses it. No armature, attachments or moving parts reported, so a hand, hook or strap passes freely.

style.reason: Brass hue and saturation match the revision reference: on the 1280 x 720 preview the brass pixels (69.6 percent of 81,114 foreground) have median hue 31.1 deg and saturation 0.478 versus 32.5 deg and 0.478 on the approved front (65.4 percent of 289,722 foreground). texture_00 has mean RGB 90.2/70.4/46.6, sd 46.0/35.8/24.0, 104,511 distinct colours, with pale grey salt bloom (5.33 percent of preview foreground versus 1.08 percent reference) and verdigris (hue 120-240 deg, S above 0.15, V above 0.10: 0.51 percent versus 1.19 percent). Bloom is heavier and verdigris about half, but both read as salt-corroded brass rather than the copper-orange batch2-4 failure.

material_appearance.reason: The combined map matches the role maps exactly: vintage_lantern_3d_model_rm_metallic_smoothness.png is 1024 x 1024 RGBA; R is byte-identical to texture_02 (max abs diff 0 over 1,048,576 px) and A is byte-identical to 255 minus texture_03 (max abs diff 0), so metallic is in R and 1-roughness in A; G=B=0 is intentional packing. No map is constant: base 104,511 unique colours (sd 46.0/35.8/24.0), normal 31,900 unique (mean 127.11/126.90/254.01, sd 7.87/8.77/4.56), metallic 256 levels (mean 74.21, sd 52.09, 0-255), roughness 185 levels (mean 67.36, sd 37.99, 0-215). The Blender material links texture_02 to Metallic and texture_03 to Roughness.
